section_1_text: Fueled by maple iced lattes and my faith, I spend my days figuring out how to be a better wife, dog mom, and photographer. If you're the kind of person who loves a little adventure, doesn't take life too seriously, and enjoys a good laugh, I have a feeling we'll get along just great!
section_2_text: As a photographer, I always love to try new things and I am not afraid of a bit of adventure. Whether romping your truck through a field, going for a swim in a river, or creating photos that involve camouflage and a tree stand (still waiting for that dream session hint hint) it's an honor that you trust me to tell your story. I am that photographer who is all in on your session!
section_3_text: I picked up my first camera shortly after getting married in 2018, and I was hooked almost immediately. I've always loved anything creative, so photography became the perfect way to combine my love for art with my love for people. In 2019, I officially started my photography business on the Southern Maine seacoast where I grew up. Then, in the spring of 2022, my husband and I packed up our life and moved to the Littleton area of Northern New Hampshire, and I've been photographing amazing people here ever since.
section_4_text: At the end of the day, my favorite part of this job isn't just creating beautiful images, it's getting to know the amazing people in front of my camera. Every session has a story worth telling and it's an honor that you trust me to capture a small piece of yours. I can't wait to meet you, laugh with you, and create photos you'll treasure for all years to come!
